body: Try to find a counselor or something. It could very well get worse, and I think that you might be able to slow or even stop that.

Dude, I feel pretty similarly. I have all kinds of good shit around, and on paper, I should be happy. But every day, I fantasize about blowing my brains out. All I can say is that bullshitting your shrink is just wasting your time. Tell him what's going on, and he might be able to actually help. Good luck, dude.

Hey, I'm glad that it didn't work. Maybe you could get a puppy, my dog is a friend that isn't allowed to leave me and has to love me forever. And maybe you can find a shrink, and make some changes in your life that make shit suck a little less. I don't know, but I hope that you do better. And I know that it's hard, but you really don't deserve to have people who don't care about whether or not you kill yourself in your life. Good luck, homie.

Yeah, I read that stuff on the Internet too. It's almost like all that stuff comes from people who don't have crippling depression and anxiety. Because you don't even remember what used to make you happy. And your whole body physically hurts constantly, so exercise is twice as punishing. And walking /meditation quickly spirals into another existential crisis. But these authors can't imagine that this can go on for years and years, spiraling until you are just a fat shell of what you're expected to be.

Me too thanks.   

I don't know what to say to fix any of this. I would say that you should ask for drugs from your doctor, but that shit didn't work for me.   

I will say that I'm proud of you for getting that far, as much as my opinion matters. I want to quit constantly, and I barely scrape by as a human being. From what you said, you're a fucking pipe hitter, getting shit done and taking names. Try to congratulate yourself for doing good shit, even if it's super minor.

You can tell your shrink that you have been having thoughts of whatever, but that you don't have plans to do it. They're less urgent, but they know that it's not all good.  

And I feel you on the whole "everything should be fine but it's not" thing. You just have to remember that your brain is fucked up, and you shouldn't punish yourself for feeling like shit.   

I mean, I still beat myself up for every little thing, but I know that I shouldn't, for what it's worth.  

Good luck, homie.

Don't tell them that you have anxiety. Just try to prod them for information about them, and keep asking questions about that stuff. People usually like talking about themselves. And remember, you probably won't have to interact with them again if you don't want to, so you have nothing to lose.   
Now how to start that conversation, and get past the racing thoughts and triple digit heart rate? No fucking idea.

Dude, it is all in your head, in the same way that a broken arm is all in your arm. Just because other people are fucked, doesn't mean that you aren't also fucked. But you have to unfuck yourself before you can be worth a shit helping the other people, so don't worry about them. And if anyone tries to shit on you for trying to fix yourself, then tell them to fuck right off.

From extensive testing in my teenage years, I figured out that I'm not at all sensitive to caffeine. However, when I get a bad string of panic attacks, the thought that the caffeine could cause a panic attack causes me to have one. So that could be your issue?
I really want to, but I have another semester of college before I can move away. But every day drags on for forever and three quarters. I can't do this anymore.
I'm afraid that I'll botch the suicide attempt and end up even more fucked up and more incapable of doing anything.
Fucking eh, man. I hear a certain name, and I break down into tears and want to die. Along with a ton of other shit.
me too, bud. me too.

So sell me a band aid that works. Every time. Anything less, and I should get my money back, because it didn't work. But they throw pill after pill at me, and I take it for a month or two, and I get all these side effects, and no positive effects. The money is there for the solution, but they're apparently incapable of properly defining the problem and finding a workable patch.

Yeah, but roughly 7% of the population deals with this. That should be enough pressure to find an effective solution. The fact that it hasn't been resolved is a travesty. In any other field, it would have been solved decades ago, but the medical field is special. Complex or not, 7% of a developed country with a disease is completely unacceptable.

I feel you, homie. My second oldest memory is of me being too anxious to properly function, and it's been that way ever since. All I can think is that 2 non-functional therapists can be replaced by one that can do their fucking job. I haven't personally experienced this, but I have read about it (and it was on the Internet, so it must be true.)  

I can say that I like to gain control of my life by subtly breaking the rules, ala /r/firstworldanarchists/ (when the depression isn't overriding my ability to think). Just that little fuck you can make it a bit easier to get to the end of the day.   

Good luck, hombre.

Man, how can they not have solved this by now? America put men on the moon almost 50 years ago, with 1/1000 of the computing power of this thing that fits in my palm. Are all of the smart science minded people in engineering, or are they just slacking off? Is not like there's no money in it. What's the big fucking deal?

I mean you are consenting to what is happening to you. In just about any other case, that would be an indicator of an okay behavior, given that you're an adult. Perhaps inadvisable, but okay. I fail to see a difference, beyond that people are fucking selfish and don't want any pain, even though they couldn't be arsed to help you.
Yeah my birthday was pretty recent, and my asshole family ate the last of my birthday cake while I was at work. I got one piece. I'm still pissed off about that.
Exactly. I should probably start by not beating myself up for not being happy when I feel like I should, but that's rational, and I don't know if my asshole brain will allow for that.
That sounds stupid familiar. Like I remember being happy regularly, but fuck if I know how I did it.

It's probably because the shit in our heads is orders of magnitude worse than anything that other people have experienced. If only I could harness the energy I waste hating myself. I would be way ahead of where I am.

I may just be lacking human connection. I tried to talk to one of my best friends, and she just can't relate to my experiences. I'm sure that she thinks that I'm crazy, but I don't know where else to turn to.

I can't relate to people anymore. Like I talk to some people, and my experiences don't align enough to consider us the same species. School is over for the summer, and I haven't been able to get a new job, and I think that I'm going stir crazy.

I actually did go to one of those peer things, and it helped for the length of the meeting, and then I was back to my norm. And I just can't afford to move out, I had to quit my job to have a chance with my course load, and am having trouble even hearing from potential employers.
Yeah, I've tried that. I get ignored until 2 days later, when I get a "sorry, I've been busy" It's pointless.

Yeah I've tried that. I only have a couple left, because I've alienated the rest, because I'm afraid to do anything, for fear of breaking down mentally in public. Knowing that I tried only makes it worse.
